title: Amazon Associates
one_liner: Share a product link and earn a cut when someone buys.
pay: Most categories pay about 3% to 4.5%. Example: a $40 item at 4.5% earns about $1.80.
steps: Apply on the Amazon Associates site with your channel or website.
Create links to products you actually use.
Share them with clear disclosure ("As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases").
Make 3 qualifying sales in your first 180 days to keep the account.
catch: You need 3 qualifying sales in your first 180 days, or the account is closed. Rates differ by category and some were cut in 2026.

match.first_step: Make one 'things I actually use' video and add your links.
